**Final Round Advancements:** For all events with more than one round, we will be taking a minimum of 6 Irish competitors to the final. If necessary, we will increase the size of the final by one competitor at a time until we have enough Irish competitors.

**Please Note:** As this is the Irish Championship, only competitors who represent Ireland will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete.

**Fewest Moves Challenge**: FMC will not be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at[ Irish Championship FMC 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IrishChampionshipFMC2023) on 1st July instead.

items.name: NZ South Island Championship 2023

venue.name: Cashmere High School
venue.address: 172 Rose Street, Somerfield, Christchurch 8024, New Zealand

items.information:
NZ South Island Championship 2023 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

In addition, NZ South Island Championship 2023 is the first regional championship of 2023 in the lead up to Nationals later in 2023.
